unitNotes.V3-17: V3-17, RS26 remainder (contracts/actions-sos.md lines 111, 130). Store.status() gains lockId: an opaque string while a lock row exists, null when none; a NEW value whenever the lock row is created (set PIN), replaced (change PIN; replaceAll or import that writes a lock row, even one that carried an id; reset then set) or removed (remove PIN, erase: null); never derived from the PIN, salt or check (random bytes). Kept in the lock row, so a reload keeps it and a second Store over the same storage (another tab) reads the new value after its load; Node memory mode the same. store.test.mjs: each transition changes it; unchanged across reload; null without a lock; no PIN, salt or check inside it; a second instance sees the change. No other Store API change; an old export without the field imports with a fresh id.
unitNotes.V3-16: V3-16: N1, N2, Q-a of contracts/core.md lines 117-119 (ui-core.js UI.form custom field focus, about :370-380). N1: role=group only on a plain div or span; a node with an implicit role (ul, ol, table, svg, fieldset ...) keeps it, still named by aria-labelledby. N2: a contenteditable node counts as a control (no tabindex -1, no role=group). Q-a: a native control returned as the node gets aria-labelledby the field label's id when the page named it no other way. Tests in store.test.mjs's UI.form block.
